caption:
A swordswoman battles a giant horned beast.
Seedance 2.5 turned a city street into a battlefield.
prompt:
VIDEO PROMPT — 30 seconds. 16:9 landscape. High-budget live-action urban fantasy action, photoreal with cinematic VFX: 35mm and wide anamorphic lenses, bright natural midday sunlight with hard shadows, crisp blue sky, teal-and-warm grade, cyan lens flares, realistic dust and debris. Camera feel: big-budget blockbuster, fast drone and low ground-level tracking moves, slight handheld shake on impacts. Pacing: calm 1.5-second opening, then relentless escalating action, ending on a still close-up.

CHARACTERS:
- THE SWORDSWOMAN: young East Asian woman, early 20s, fair skin, slim athletic build, delicate oval face, dark calm eyes, straight jet-black hair pulled up in a high ponytail with long loose strands framing her face, a thin dark wooden stick hairpin through the hair tie. Black long-sleeved martial-arts jacket with wrap front, black leggings, black fingerless leather gloves, black high-top canvas sneakers with white soles and white rubber toe caps. Signature details: a hip sash/tassets of hanging black panels patterned with white geometric stripes on her left hip, and a katana in a black scabbard with a red-and-black wrapped handle and a round black guard. When drawn, the blade glows with swirling dark green and cyan energy.
- THE BEAST: a massive muscular horned monster about four times her height, hunched ape-like build with huge shoulders and very long arms, rough cracked dark grey-brown skin with mauve-pink veiny muscle on the chest and face, two thick curved horns and spiky bony ridges along the head, shoulders and back, small glowing eyes, enormous clawed hands with long dark talons.

LOCATION: a wide multi-lane city intersection on a bright sunny day: grey asphalt with white zebra crosswalks and lane lines, a pale stone sidewalk corner with yellow tactile paving strips, traffic signals on long overhead arms, street trees, a few yellow taxis and a red car. Background: modern glass office towers, the main one a tall curved blue-glass office building right behind the sidewalk corner; a beige stone office block on one side of the street.

SHOT 1 (00:00.0-00:01.3) — Drone dive. High-angle aerial drone shot looking almost straight down at the intersection, tilted, cars and taxis moving across the crosswalks; the drone dives fast and pushes in toward the sidewalk corner, where the tiny figure of the woman stands alone on the yellow tactile strips.
SHOT 2 (00:01.3-00:03.8) — The facade bursts. Ground-level front wide shot, slow push-in: the woman stands calmly, feet together, arms at her sides, centered on the sidewalk, the curved glass office building behind her. MUST SHOW: the glass facade directly behind her bulges and explodes outward in a huge spray of glittering glass shards and grey dust, and the beast crashes through and lands hunched right behind her, shards raining down. She does not move.
SHOT 3 (00:03.8-00:08.8) — The grab. Very low angle from knee height, tilted dutch frame, close on her front: the beast looms over her, filling the frame against the sky and glass towers, cyan lens flare on the left edge, dust and debris drifting. It slowly reaches one giant clawed hand forward over her head toward the lens. MUST SHOW: at 00:06.3 she dissolves from the feet up into a dense cloud of dark black smoke laced with glittering emerald-green particles; the claw closes on empty smoke, then slams down into the pavement, throwing a thick wave of dust that fills the frame.
SHOT 4 (00:08.8-00:11.3) — The draw. Street-level side tracking shot moving fast with her: she reappears on the cracked asphalt, sprints low from behind-camera toward the beast standing in the dust down the street, draws the katana from her hip and drops into a deep crouched lunge. MUST SHOW: the blade trails a long glowing ribbon of dark green and cyan energy along its full length. At 00:11.0 she bursts into a swirl of green smoke as she dashes forward.
SHOT 5 (00:11.3-00:13.3) — Flying kick. Low angle looking up, camera swinging upward to follow her: she flies high through the air above the street, the beige office block and traffic signals behind, and drives a mid-air flying side kick into the beast's jaw; its horned head snaps sideways.
SHOT 6 (00:13.3-00:15.9) — Slash. Wide street-level tracking shot from behind her, yellow taxi parked on the left: she lands, sprints between the beast's legs and slashes upward at its fist and wrist. MUST SHOW: bright golden-orange sparks spray from the cut, leaving a glowing orange-red gash across the beast's wrist.
SHOT 7 (00:15.9-00:20.3) — Ground pound. Low front wide shot, slow push-in: the beast towers over her, its glowing orange wrist wound visible; she ducks and runs beneath it, sword low. It rears up with both arms raised, a burst of glowing green energy flaring from its lower torso, then slams both fists into the street; the asphalt cracks and buckles and a massive wall of thick grey-brown dust swallows the whole frame.
SHOT 8 (00:20.3-00:23.3) — Inside the dust. Very low ground-level camera in the dust, slight shake: broken slabs of asphalt and rubble in the foreground, the beast's huge silhouette emerging and smashing down again; at 00:23.0 a bright burst of green energy explodes against its torso and it staggers.
SHOT 9 (00:23.3-00:27.4) — Reappear. Low wide shot across the cracked crosswalk, traffic signals upper left, glass towers behind: the beast staggers and crouches in the centre of the intersection, half turned away, dust rolling. At 00:25.0 she materializes in the left foreground out of a swirl of dark green smoke and settles into a wide fighting stance, back three-quarters to camera, katana raised beside her head, facing the beast.
SHOT 10 (00:27.4-00:30.1) — Final close-up. Close-up from the front, shallow depth of field, city street blurred behind her, locked-off with a very slow push-in: she holds the katana horizontally across her lower face and chest, gloved hands on the red-and-black wrapped handle on the left, the blade running across the frame just below her eyes, wisps of dark green smoke curling off it. She stares intensely and unblinking straight into the lens, loose strands of hair stirring, hairpin visible.

SOUND: Driving cinematic action instrumental (heavy taiko drums, low brass, rising strings) building throughout, no vocals. Shot 1: wind rush of the drone dive, distant city traffic. Shot 2: deep crack, then a huge glass explosion and shards tinkling to the ground. Shot 3: low guttural monster growl, rumbling breath; a soft whoosh as she dissolves into smoke; heavy thud and debris as the claw hits the road. Shot 4: fast footsteps, metallic ring of the katana drawn, humming energy hiss along the blade, smoke whoosh. Shot 5: wind whoosh, bone-heavy kick impact, monster grunt. Shot 6: sword slash with sparking metallic screech. Shot 7: furious roar, two massive ground-shaking slams, asphalt cracking, rolling dust boom. Shot 8: muffled rumble, energy blast. Shot 9: smoke whoosh, monster snarl. Shot 10: music drops to a low drone with a soft blade hum and one final drum hit. No dialogue.
prompt_short: 30s 16:9 live-action urban fantasy. A young East Asian swordswoman in black stands at a sunny city intersection as a giant horned beast bursts through a glass tower. She vanishes into green smoke, slashes with a glowing katana, kicks its jaw, ends staring into camera.
